# Plonky3 vectors for the Wiedemann tower basis.
#
# The tower is T_0 = GF(2) and T_{k+1} = T_k[X_k] / (X_k^2 + X_{k-1} X_k + 1), with X_{-1} = 1.
# An element of T_{k+1} occupies the low 2^{k+1} bits of an integer.
# Its low half is the coefficient of 1 and its high half the coefficient of X_k, recursively.
#
# Every value below is that integer in big-endian hex, padded to the level's width.
# Records are:
#
#   level <bits>          every following record is read at this width
#   mul <a> <b> <a*b>     a product in the tower basis
#   inv <a> <1/a>         a multiplicative inverse, with zero excluded
#   cantor <i> <v_i>      the i-th Cantor basis vector, v_0 = 1 and v_i^2 + v_i = v_{i-1}
#
# Cantor vectors are listed once at the widest level.
# A narrower level embeds the same elements, so it reads the same patterns truncated.
#
# Products and inverses were computed from the recurrence above by a reference written
# independently of this crate, not dumped from it.

level 8
mul 01 02 02
mul 02 01 02
mul ff 80 ed
mul 80 ff ed
mul 5e 55 79
mul 55 5e 79
mul 55 e3 ae
mul e3 55 ae
inv 01 01
inv 02 03
inv ff cb
inv 80 d3

level 16
mul 0001 0002 0002
mul 0002 0001 0002
mul ffff 8000 c3ed
mul 8000 ffff c3ed
mul d065 6248 0802
mul 6248 d065 0802
mul 5fdd 0be5 86ad
mul 0be5 5fdd 86ad
inv 0001 0001
inv 0002 0003
inv ffff be75
inv 8000 d30d

level 32
mul 00000001 00000002 00000002
mul 00000002 00000001 00000002
mul ffffffff 80000000 622ec3ed
mul 80000000 ffffffff 622ec3ed
mul 6e6b43d5 6d6a5ece c195e1fd
mul 6d6a5ece 6e6b43d5 c195e1fd
mul 1b63f0f6 7614f6ed a4191908
mul 7614f6ed 1b63f0f6 a4191908
inv 00000001 00000001
inv 00000002 00000003
inv ffffffff 75b9cbcc
inv 80000000 d30d00d3

mul 0000000000000001 0000000000000002 0000000000000002
mul 0000000000000002 0000000000000001 0000000000000002
mul ffffffffffffffff 8000000000000000 b9a1a1c3622ec3ed
mul 8000000000000000 ffffffffffffffff b9a1a1c3622ec3ed
mul 31656f879cdb81ee 66d75ad4db51bfa0 ba39089b43ee2cb1
mul 66d75ad4db51bfa0 31656f879cdb81ee ba39089b43ee2cb1
mul 0726572bc9711d14 3577aeb4db01ff44 f9e056dfabb0b812
mul 3577aeb4db01ff44 0726572bc9711d14 f9e056dfabb0b812
inv 0000000000000001 0000000000000001
inv 0000000000000002 0000000000000003
inv ffffffffffffffff cbcc7572be75bebe
inv 8000000000000000 d30d00d30000d30d
